note: Quick, Draw! popsicle 5267945372516352: stroke 0 is the line across the bottom of the bar, stroke 1 is the rounded outline of the bar, stroke 2 is the stick hanging below it, stroke 3 is a short mark at the lower right of the bar. The film's bar is a rigid ice-cream bar that floats tilted and turns a little, so the whole drawing is placed by two points on the bar's centre line, the middle of its rounded top and the middle of its flat bottom edge; those two points set where it is, how big and how tilted. Nothing bends. The footage holds the bar still for the whole interval (its measured axis moves under one pixel and turns under half a degree), so every key is the same placement and the drawing holds; track is off because point tracking only added jitter.
